rules_in_order.rule: The public task language is absent from the target model profile's supported languages.
The target model has a predeclared high capability tier and supports the task language.
A verified portable transfer is available, its public-text overlap meets the threshold, and its estimated context share is within budget.
A schema-valid compact current-task scout is already acquired, its use is explicitly permitted, and its estimated context share is within budget.
The target model has a predeclared low capability tier and no earlier assistance rule qualified.
The deterministic workspace profile has high structural uncertainty and no earlier assistance rule qualified.
No assistance or escalation rule qualified, so preserve an unaided target-model attempt.
